findings.description: Uses a mutable default argument causing shared state across calls, leading to cross‑call data leakage.
findings.rationale: The default dict is created once at function definition time; every invocation mutates the same object, so data from one call persists into subsequent calls, breaking isolation and potentially exposing sensitive information.
